name: peppermint/project
description: Project core for Laravel — a project identity other systems hang their own meaning on, with application-defined kinds and status vocabularies, and column mapping for products whose tables are older than this package.

suggest.laravel/mcp: For the package's base MCP tools. Optional — the package works without it.
suggest.peppermint/tasks: For the task bridge: tasks belonging to a project. Optional — the package works without it.
suggest.peppermint/calendar: For the calendar bridge: appointments belonging to a project. Optional — the package works without it.
suggest.peppermint/time: For the time bridge: time booked against a project. Optional — the package works without it.
